key.name: flash-on-waiting-agents
key.description: Briefly expand the notch of Visor when a T3 Code agent starts waiting for an approval.

key.name: server-url
key.description: Address of the T3 Code server, such as http://127.0.0.1:3773. Empty: the server running on this machine, found through its runtime file below ~/.t3.

key.name: token-origin
key.summary: Origin of the T3 Code access token
key.description: Address of the server the module is paired with, such as http://127.0.0.1:3773. Empty: not paired, T3 Code sessions are not shown. The access token itself is in the keyring and is sent to this server only.

key.name: token-serial
key.summary: Changes of the T3 Code access token
key.description: Counted up by the settings window whenever it stored or removed the access token in the keyring, so that the module reads it again.
